title: Descriptif Diagonale des Fous 2025 — official course description
claims: The official 2025 course description tells runners to keep the Colorado trail on their right because it has been closed since cyclone Garance passed.
The description routes runners through Piton Trésor, the Rampes de la Montagne, the Chemin des Perles and on to the Belvédère de la Vigie.
The same document places CP20 Colorado at km 171.6 and the finish at La Redoute at km 178.6.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接读取官方 2025 赛道说明 PDF。文件为 2025 届版本，与 2026 届关门表的点位里程不同，引用时按届次区分。
